mechanism: Copy the visible square template unchanged at every three-dot marker.

If the template is exactly a hollow square outline, remove the non-corner cells from its two sides farthest from the owning missing-corner anchor, then copy that shape at every marker. Other templates remain unchanged.
draft_notes.context_policy: Every demonstration must match a candidate full output. Query answered only when all surviving candidates agree. No shape-remap dictionary, nearest-owner selection, first tie break, or demo skipping.
draft_notes.domain: The owning marker is unique. Marker triples explain every marker-colour pixel. Template span2 or3 is guaranteed by unchanged native random domain. All target squares must be in bounds. Copies combine by nonzero-pixel union, including legitimate zero-cell overlap.
draft_notes.independent_gate: independent_gate.py uses Chebyshev-connected marker components and signed anchor-offset pixel sets, independently of factory neighbourhood triples and reflected masks. require_evidence checks all demo/query inputs and ignores query output fields.
draft_notes.regression: Original failing demo owner region grew from4 to5 template-colour pixels because another copy overlapped a zero cell. Old learning table misinterpreted this as a shape change. New code constructs stamp union directly.
draft_notes.limitations: Two explicitly declared uniform geometric mechanisms; finite hypothesis class, not proof of unique original intended rule.
